title: Implementation Map
description: How each facit acceptance criterion is implemented today, grounded in real code/test references. Keyed by AC id (a foreign key into facit.json). The honest 'how it's implemented' half of the stories->gap->build loop. Referential integrity (every acId exists in the facit) is checked by the facit CLI, not by this schema.

facitVersion.description: The facitHash of the facit.json this map was derived against (so staleness is detectable).

acId.description: FK to a facit AC id.

status.description: obsolete = code exists for an AC the facit no longer has.

ref.description: file:line or test id, a verified real reference (not paraphrase).

notes.description: How it is implemented; what is partial or missing.

proof.description: Where + how this AC is PROVEN. Enforced by the CLI once the AC is claimed proven: the proving test(s) — the behaviour verdict — and the files those tests cover (auto-derived from coverage, never hand-listed), each with a content-hash that triggers re-running the covering test on code drift. A proven AC with no test binding is rejected, so 'where/how is this proven?' is always answerable and verifiable.

tests.description: proving test ids — the verdict that the code satisfies this AC

hash.description: content-hash of the file at proof time; a change triggers re-running the covering test (the test, not the hash, is the verdict)

coveredFiles.description: files the proving tests execute, from coverage
